CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION users_refresh_poem_compositions_search_vec_trg() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE poem_compositions SET search_vec = setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(title, ''))), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(pen_name, ''))), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(NEW.username, ''))), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(content, ''))), 'C') WHERE user_id = NEW.id;
RETURN NEW; END $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_poem_compositions_search_vec ON poem_compositions USING gin (search_vec);
